items.name: coinscriber
items.description: Coinscriber is an off-chain crypto bot which works along coinsniper smart contract to search for new listed tokens on Pancakeswap with enough liquidity, and then allows you to buy the coin using our smart contract called coinsniper. After 5mins or more making profits, you sell the token and keep your profits. The process recycled until stopped.
